name: Understand
description: Align on business objectives, users, current constraints, success criteria, and the evidence needed to make good decisions.

name: Architect
description: Compare suitable approaches, map interfaces and dependencies, and make trade-offs explicit before implementation.

name: Build
description: Develop the solution in clear increments, using maintainable code, documented interfaces, and appropriate engineering practices.

name: Validate
description: Test behavior, compatibility, security, reliability, and performance where relevant to the agreed requirements.

name: Improve
description: Use findings and operational feedback to prioritize fixes, reduce risk, and plan the next useful iteration.
